attribution: CSKG: The CommonSense Knowledge Graph, Ilievski, Szekely & Zhang, ESWC 2021, USC Information Sciences Institute. This bundle is a trimmed subset of CSKG, distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0; ShareAlike applies to this bundle data. CSKG unifies ConceptNet, WordNet, FrameNet, ATOMIC, Roget's Thesaurus, a Wikidata subset and Visual Genome; each edge in the bundle keeps its source code (AT, CN, CN|WN, WN) so component provenance survives.

feederMap.endpointRule: Concept relations: both endpoints must classify (curated table in classify.ts, or the WordNet climb in wordnet-lex.ts). ATOMIC relations: event-rule anchoring (known head verb on the event side, classifiable head word on the other side).
feederMap.englishRule: Concept-relation rows: both node ids under /c/en/. ATOMIC rows pass on their relation (ATOMIC is English-only; its node ids live in the at: space). Rows sourced exactly VG (Visual Genome) are excluded.

generator: Trim of the locally installed full extract (data/raw/cskg/cskg.tsv.gz) by the fork feeder's own rules (src/fork/cskg-feed.ts, mapTriple), produced by scripts/build-cskg-bundle.mjs (npm run fork:build-cskg-bundle). The bundle was first generated as Run 2 of the CSKG trim measurement (2026-11-17); this script is that staged procedure — relation filter, English/source rules, mapTriple as the endpoint stage — committed.

parts.format: Lean TSV, four columns, no header: from (mapTriple's normalised output — concept label, or full phrase for ATOMIC), relation (as spelled in the source data), to, source code. Plain text, not gzipped, so the bundle diffs like the repo's other shipped data parts.
